originality.rationale: Substantive delta over nearest priors verified live. OEIS A000372 records only Dedekind totals 2,3,6,20,168,7581,7828354... with no rank-layer breakdown. OEIS A059119 records only size-only triangle a(n,m); row n=5 is [1,32,285,1090,2020,2146,1380,490,115,20,2] which explains T5 size marginals (32->30 after removing {empty},{[5]}) and row n=6 tail [..326990,147440,57675,19238,5325,1170,190,20,1] which matches M6 sizes 12-20, but neither gives joint profile vectors (a_i)->N for T5 or M6. De Causmaecker & De Wannemacker arXiv:1407.4288 computes Dedekind totals via interval decomposition (to n=8) with structural lemmas for totals, not rank-profile census or T5/M6 Dilworth witnesses. Ilinca & Kahn arXiv:1202.4427 gives log-asymptotics for maximal antichains only (fetch transport error on recheck; description corroborated via topic admission and A000372 link text citing Order 30(2) 427-435). Live OEIS keyword search 'rank profile antichain truncated' returns no match; live arXiv all-fields search 'rank profile antichain truncated Boolean' returns no results. Widths 10 and 20 alone are Sperner-immediate (admitted in DRAFT §2) but headline is the complete 94-cell and 362-cell joint tables plus replayable Dilworth/Sperner logs, which are not mechanically implied: e.g. T5 max cell (0,2,2,0)->390 and M6 top cells (1,8,0)/(0,8,1)->193050 require cross-rank comparability counting, not binomial layer arithmetic (only pure-layer cells like (0,10,0)=C(20,10)=184756 are trivial). No prior source publishes these tables.

value.rationale: Strongest headline (complete M6 362-cell census with 7741776 antichains + complete T5 94-cell census with 7579 antichains + 10/20-chain Dilworth certificates) is an exact invariant of specific natural objects, motivated before computation, not known or mechanically implied, and plausibly retrievable. T5=B5 minus {empty,top} is the classical truncated Boolean lattice; M6=B6[2,3,4] is the standard Peck middle-rank selection where Sperner width concentrates (rank sizes 15,20,15). Motivation (Sperner/Peck phenomena, Kruskal-Katona shadows, monotone-Boolean classification) with stated downstream uses (Peck/shadow tightness tests, classifier benchmarks) predates computation. Joint distributions are absent from totals/size-only tables; certification (witnesses, symmetry, chain partitions, hashes) is used as evidence, not as value itself. This exceeds the fallback (T5 table + one M6 width witness). It is not a textbook restatement (widths alone would be, but tables are not), not a parameter substitution, not a tiny gain, and not an unexplained enumeration (every cell has witness, symmetry and marginal arithmetic). Under the value standard, one exact order/table/witness datum for a motivated natural object qualifies without a new general theorem; no completed census beyond stated slices or downstream theorem is demanded.
